Whether the figure on your statement is already declared, whether it may be withdrawn, and how a withdrawal would affect policy WL-60705385 depend on its terms. We should check the policy and current illustration before answering those points or arranging an updated illustration.

Yours sincerely,
Customer Service Team
rationale: Separates declared and projected benefits, accurately scopes general participating-policy concepts, and defers policy-specific withdrawal and document availability.
